decisive_items: Congo red staining results were positive
Polarizing light microscopy demonstrated pale apple-green birefringence
response.rationale: Systemic features (anemia, liver/renal involvement, proteinuria) plus biopsy-proven amyloid with apple-green birefringence favor primary systemic amyloidosis over generic or cutaneous-limited forms.

rejected.why: Lacks systemic involvement and biopsy confirmation; dyschromia pattern not described.
Cutaneous-only label ignores systemic organ dysfunction and proteinuria.
Too nonspecific; primary systemic amyloidosis is the precise diagnosis supported by systemic findings.
